content: {"like":["Values high-quality storytelling with strong, lovable characters and compelling drama","Prefers well-written, well-directed, well-acted, and well-edited productions","Enjoys narratives that culminate in satisfying, often happy or fantastic endings","Shows interest in true stories and content that encourages positive action (e.g., Great Commission)","Appreciates light‑hearted romance, mini‑series formats, and sweeping visual settings"],"dislike":["Dislikes coarse, vulgar, or overly sexual content and foul language","Avoids slow pacing, tedious or painful viewing experiences","Rejects low-quality, cheesy, or poorly acted productions","Prefers family‑friendly material, avoiding content unsuitable for children","Dislikes content that feels forced, negative, or unrealistic"]}
